questions.questionText: What is the System Importance Classification for this application?
questions.hintText: IBS = Important Business Service, BPS = Business Prioritised Service. Select all that apply.

questions.questionText: Is IITA (Important IT Asset) applicable for this application?
questions.hintText: Select Yes if this application is classified as an Important IT Asset.

questions.questionText: What is the planned migration strategy?
questions.hintText: Lift & Shift = move as-is, Refactor = re-architect for cloud, Deboard = decommission

questions.questionText: Provide the URL or reference for the last restore test report.
questions.hintText: e.g. BRETT report URL, Confluence page, or 'Not yet performed'

questions.questionText: What is the Recovery Time Objective (RTO)?
questions.hintText: The maximum acceptable downtime after a failure. e.g. '4 hours', '30 minutes'

questions.questionText: What is the Recovery Point Objective (RPO)?
questions.hintText: The maximum acceptable data loss. e.g. '1 hour', '15 minutes', 'Zero (no data loss)'

questions.questionText: What is the regular maintenance window?
questions.hintText: Select one or more days, then set start and end times in HKT (UTC+8).
